protocol.holdout_status: Selection-excluded in this run; previously inspected, NOT untouched independent validation
protocol.adaptive: Choose two-week only when previous four completed weekly origins have >=10% lower absolute weekly error than four-week; otherwise four-week. Per target, all inner outcomes before outer cutoff.
protocol.robust_guests: Four-week baseline bookings; median of four matching-weekday guest counts, including zeros; no source rows deleted
protocol.trend_adjusted: Four-week forecast scaled by 1+0.5*(clip(mean last14 / mean preceding14,0.5,1.5)-1); factor range0.75..1.25. Both means zero =>1; older mean zero and recent positive =>1.25
protocol.operational: Python nonnegative round; positive guests imply >=1 booking; guest floor uses pre-cutoff median nonzero-day guests/bookings rounded to2 decimals; guests>=bookings
protocol.selection: Development operational WAPE, weekly RMSE then fixed method order for ties; one choice per target from complete same-method pairs. Mixed pair is fully re-scored; never selected from holdout.
protocol.gates: Each target: >=5% relative weekly WAPE and MAE gains; weekly RMSE and daily WAPE <=105% control; absolute weekly bias <=control absolute bias +10% control weekly MAE; low-demand MAE <=110% control. Zero-week error must not worsen where observed.
protocol.output: Isolated JSON only; no changes to serving files or data
